notes: Type the size printed on your tyre (26 x 1.50, 700x25C, 40-559) and Cyclone works out the wheel size.
Brand or model not listed? Type your own.
Fixed: stops ahead on Android 8 and 9 (a missing certificate); 700 × 30C wheel size corrected to 2146 mm (bikes on it move by themselves).

messages.title: Welcome to the Cyclone beta
messages.text: Thanks for testing Cyclone! To get started: download the map for your area (Options → Offline maps), and turn off battery optimisation for Cyclone (Options → This phone) so rides record smoothly with the screen off. New versions show up here as a notification. Found a bug or have an idea? Options → Beta & updates → Report on GitHub. Ride safe!

messages.title: New in 0.11: routes from Google Maps
messages.text: Update to 0.11.0, then try it: plan a route in Google Maps (motorbike mode works well), tap Share and pick Cyclone route. A start and a destination are enough; add stops to steer the route along the roads you want. Cyclone draws a bike route through your stops, with climbs and turn-by-turn. The way back when you leave the route now works offline with no extra app: the routing data for your area (about 40 MB) downloads by itself on Wi-Fi. The speed bar also no longer fills up at 40 km/h. Tell us how it goes: Options → Beta & updates → Report on GitHub.

messages.title: New in 0.12: send problem reports
messages.text: Thanks to the tester who told us about a force close last night! From 0.12.0 Cyclone notes what happened when it closes unexpectedly and offers to send a report at the next start. Please update, then if it happens again: tap the notification, or Options → Beta & updates → Send problem report. Your e-mail app opens addressed to cyclonebikeco@gmail.com with the report attached; just press Send. If you had the force close before updating, open Beta & updates once after updating: Cyclone may still find it in Android's records and offer to send it.

messages.title: New in 0.13: Gear and Stats
messages.text: Two new tiles on the home screen. Gear: add your bike (type is enough; brand, model, tyre and a photo are optional). The tyre size sets the speed from a wheel sensor, and each bike keeps its own sensors and counts its own km. Have more than one bike? Tap Ride this bike before you set off. Stats: pick a goal, like 100 km a week, and Cyclone shows your progress and what it takes to get there, plus streaks and how this week, month or year compares with the last. Your bike not in the list? Type it in and tick Suggest; we add new bikes to the list without an app update.

messages.title: New in 0.14.1: right distance, day colours
messages.text: Thanks to the testers who compared Cyclone with a Coros and asked about Strava! Without a speed sensor, Cyclone measured distance about 10 % short; it now follows your GPS track, drops GPS jumps, and shows speed the same way Strava does. Rides without altitude get it from terrain data before they go to Strava, so elevation is no longer 0 m. New: day colours (black on white) for riding in the sun, switching by itself at sunrise and sunset; change it in Options → Ride options → Colours, or tap the clock on the ride screen.

messages.title: 0.14.2: fix for Cyclone closing on Start
messages.text: Thanks to the tester who sent a problem report! On some phones Cyclone closed every time you pressed Start, because Android would not create Cyclone's storage folder. 0.14.2 fixes this: rides then go to Cyclone's own storage and show up in History as usual. To update now: Options → Beta & updates → Download & install 0.14.2. If Start still fails, you'll see a message instead of a crash; please send a report from the same screen.

messages.title: 0.14.3: numbers fit every screen
messages.text: Thanks to the tester who sent a photo! On some phones the ride numbers were cut in half and the red button read "HOLD TO" without "STOP". It happened on smaller screens and when the phone's font size or display size is turned up. 0.14.3 sizes every number to fit its box, from small phones to tablets, and the home screen now scrolls instead of squashing its tiles. To update now: Options → Beta & updates → Download & install 0.14.3. Still see something cut off? Send a screenshot from the same screen.

messages.title: 0.14.4: button labels in full
messages.text: A small follow-up to 0.14.3: on Android 8 the green button showed only ► instead of ► START or ► RESUME, and on any phone the pause button lost its word after switching day/night colours. 0.14.4 always shows the full label. To update: Options → Beta & updates → Download & install 0.14.4. The tutorial pictures are new too.

messages.title: New in 0.15: ride insights
messages.text: After each ride, the summary now tells you how it went in plain words: new personal bests, how it compares with your other rides, pacing, the wind and heat on the day, and with a heart-rate sensor or power meter, how hard it was and how to recover. Update, then open any ride in History to see it. Got a heart-rate sensor? Set your age or max heart rate in Options → Rider & zones for the effort notes. Tell us what you think: Options → Beta & updates → Report on GitHub.

messages.title: 0.15.2: stops ahead on every route
messages.text: On some routes, including ones made in Google Maps, the Ahead page never showed stops, however often you synced: one empty answer from the OpenStreetMap stops server was kept for good. Cyclone 0.15.2 fixes it, and those routes get their stops at the next sync (or tap Online → Sync now). Syncing a new route is quicker too: stops come first, and a busy server is left sooner. And a GPX file with no points no longer replaces your route of the same name. To update: Options → Beta & updates → Check & update.

messages.title: 0.15.3: your tyre size, your brand
messages.text: Thanks to the tester who asked for 26 × 1.50 and their own bike brand! In Cyclone 0.15.3, Gear → edit your bike → Tyre size → Type the size on the tyre: enter what is printed on the side (26 x 1.50, 700x25C or two numbers like 40-559) for accurate speed from a wheel sensor. Brand not in the list? Tap Not listed? Type your own brand. Also fixed: stops ahead on Android 8 and 9, and the 700 × 30C wheel size (bikes on it are corrected by themselves). To update: Options → Beta & updates → Check & update.
